description:
Creates or updates Purchase Order lines identified using either ids or origin_ids.
The material on the line must already exist and can be specified using either item_id or item_origin_id.
The connected Purchase Order header must already exist.
The maximum number of entities per request is 1000. Exceeding this limit will result in a 413 response.
See https://developers.procore.com/documentation/using-sync-actions for more information.

schema.description: Class representing a procore response with data.

data.description: Record representing a sync action response, including the entities and errors.

413.description: The request body exceeds the maximum allowed batch size of 1000 entities.

items.description: Class representing a purchase order line DTO, including the contract delivery timestamp.

id.description: The Procore id of the resource. This should only be set when updating existing resources.

origin_id.description: The origin id of the resource. If an entry is missing both id and origin_id, then that entry will always be interpreted as an insert.

origin_data.description: The origin data for the resource. Procore does not interpret this value.

item_id.description: The Procore id of the item for this line. Do not specify this when using item_origin_id.

item_origin_id.description: The origin id of the item for this line. Do not specify this when using item_id.

line_number.description: The line number for this line.

subline_number.description: The subline number for this line.

warning.description: The warning message associated with this line.

contract_delivery_at.description: Timestamp when this line is contracted to have its material delivered
